name: Haruka no Sora ~Gekitou Mahjong Taikai Hen~
original_name: 遥の空 ～激闘麻雀大会編～
source:
This is another strip majong game. In the story mode, you can pick one of 6 girls to fight for a banshee tear, which can grant one wish.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
又一款脱衣麻将游戏。在故事模式中，你可以从6名女孩中选择一人，为能实现愿望的女妖之泪而战。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
